name: Priorities
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must prioritize God above all else, placing no other gods before Him and loving Him with all their heart, soul, and might. Wisdom in life comes from recognizing the brevity of our days and ordering our work and pursuits accordingly. Jesus emphasizes that one cannot serve two masters, urging believers to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, promising that all necessary things will then be provided. True priorities align with wholehearted devotion to God and wise stewardship of the time and resources He has given.
